My dad ran a tender boat. And then my sister and I were captains of a commercial fishing boat different times over the years. So that's how I was raised. I worked for Fish and Game when I was in college. I imagined I was going to become a teacher, and so I went to college teacher training. And in 1996, I ran for office, I ran for State House, and I lost by 56 votes. But in 1998, I was elected and then reelected for more time. So I served 10 years in the State House. So that's a little bit about me.

You know, my platform is being pro-jobs, pro-families, pro-fish and pro-choice.
